description: Add 'Blog' navigation link to all six public HTML pages. This is a same-pattern edit across multiple files. Independent of all other FEATs — can be done without the blog pages existing yet (the link will 404 until FEAT-003 creates blog.html, which is fine).
steps: In EACH of the following 6 files: index.html, shop.html, about.html, circle.html, checkout.html, product.html — make BOTH changes below.

Desktop nav change: In .nav-links-center, find the
AERA Circle element. Insert Blog IMMEDIATELY BEFORE that nav-dropdown div. This places Blog between About Us and AERA Circle.

Mobile menu change: In the JavaScript string that builds mm.innerHTML (search for 'm-menu' in each file), find About Us and add Blog AFTER it (before whatever comes next, which is the AERA Circle link or the .m-cta CTA).
In blog.html and blog-post.html (created by FEAT-003 and FEAT-004), ensure the Blog link has class 'active' added when on that page: Blog in the desktop nav of those pages only.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 files (index.html, shop.html, about.html, circle.html, checkout.html, product.html) have Blog in their .nav-links-center, positioned between About Us and AERA Circle
All 6 files have Blog link in their mobile menu mm.innerHTML string, positioned after About Us
Desktop nav order is: Home | Shop | About Us | Blog | AERA Circle
Mobile menu order matches desktop order
verification: Open shop.html in a browser — confirm 'Blog' appears between 'About Us' and 'AERA Circle' in the desktop nav
Resize to mobile width (≤1023px) — open hamburger menu — confirm 'Blog' appears after 'About Us'
Repeat the same check for about.html, circle.html, index.html
